class.name: NetwPlayer
class.brief_description: A player whose join was accepted.

members.member: The account [method Netw.configure_admission] assigned to [member NetwJoinRequest.account], such as [code]"steam:76561198000000000"[/code]. Empty for a guest, and empty for another player on a client.
The display name admission verified with [member account]. Every peer reads it. Empty for a guest.
The entities spawned for this player with [method Netw.spawn_player], in no particular order. Empty for a spectator.
[code]false[/code] once the player has left. Check it before using a player you stored.
The peer this player is connected as. Another player may reuse it after this one leaves.

The scene this player is in, or [code]null[/code]. It is the scene holding one of its [member entities], or else the scene it watches with [method NetwScene.watch]. It is [code]null[/code] when there are two. A client only knows about the scenes it receives.

The username from [method Netw.prepare_join]. It is empty for a peer that never called [method Netw.prepare_join]. It is kept after the player leaves. Two players may join with the same name, unless [method Netw.configure_admission] refuses it.

signal.name: scene_changed
